title: FoundryConfig
description: Consumer-repo global config (foundry.config.yaml). Mirrors src/ir/types.ts FoundryConfig, extended with an optional `personas` map keyed by node/role for per-persona overrides.

name.description: Human-readable name of the harness/agent fleet.

auth.description: How the harness authenticates to GitHub for writes (commits, PRs, comments). Mirrors src/ir/types.ts AuthConfig.

mode.description: app = GitHub App installation token (bot identity; downstream events cascade). pat = a fine-grained/classic PAT secret used directly (events cascade). github-token = the built-in GITHUB_TOKEN (zero setup, but pushes/PRs made with it do NOT trigger other workflows, so chained stages won't cascade).

token_secret.description: Name of the Actions secret holding a PAT, for mode "pat".

app_id_secret.description: Name of the Actions secret holding the GitHub App id, for mode "app".

app_key_secret.description: Name of the Actions secret holding the GitHub App private key, for mode "app".

identity.description: How the agent authenticates and signs commits. Generalized: no hardcoded bot login or app-secret names.

app_id_secret.description: Name of the Actions secret holding the GitHub App id.

app_key_secret.description: Name of the Actions secret holding the GitHub App private key.

bot_login.description: The bot login used for commits/PRs, e.g. "my-agent[bot]".

oauth_token_secret.description: Name of the Actions secret holding the agent OAuth token.

api_key_secret.description: Name of the Actions secret holding an Anthropic API key. When set, agents authenticate with it INSTEAD of the OAuth token: usage-billed and not bound to one person's subscription seat.

secrets.description: Names of additional Actions secrets exposed in EVERY agent's environment (e.g. ["SENTRY_PAT"]). The compiler passes each into the run-agent step as extra-env `NAME=${{ secrets.NAME }}`, and roles read them as $NAME. This broadens each secret's blast radius to every agent lane (which ingest untrusted issue/PR text), so grant least-privilege tokens.

conventions.description: Optional free-text repo conventions surfaced to every agent (e.g. commit style, stack notes).

allowed_tools.description: Default allowed-tools list for the agent CLI.

authors.description: Only pull requests opened by these GitHub logins reach the PR lanes (pr-review, pr-fix, PR-context analysts, review panels, sweeps). Case-insensitive. A node's own authors= attribute overrides it for that lane.

rollout.description: The rollout dial: which human PRs the pipeline looks at while it is brought to a repo gradually. Leave the block out and every PR is in scope. PRs the harness bot opened are always in scope; drafts and other bots' PRs never are (a bot is reviewed only if named in authors).

authors.description: GitHub logins whose PRs are in scope. Case-insensitive.

opt_in_label.description: A PR carrying this label is in scope, whoever opened it. A key of `labels`, or a literal label name.

skip_label.description: A PR carrying this label is never in scope. A key of `labels`, or a literal label name.

verdicts.description: The verdict words, in order: approve, request changes, escalate (default [APPROVE, REQUEST_CHANGES, ESCALATE]). A verdict is a review whose last non-empty line, trimmed, is exactly `**Verdict:** <word>`; the sweep, the mark job and the merge gate all read this one list.

markers.description: parseable markers shared by prompts + guards + enforcers.

ref.description: Pinned mode: the git ref the runtime actions are referenced at. Omit it and the compiler uses its own release tag (v<version>), so the workflows and the actions they call always come from the same release. Name an exact tag or a commit to hold them elsewhere. Do not use v1: that tag has not moved since 0.1.2.

runs_on.description: The runner label every generated job uses. Default ubuntu-latest. A node's runs_on= attribute overrides it for that node's jobs.

personas.description: Per-node/per-role overrides, keyed by the node/persona key passed as the `node` input. Any field here shadows the top-level default when that persona is resolved.

persona.description: Overrides for one persona/role. Every field is optional; unspecified fields fall back to the top-level config.
